description:
End-to-end acceptance testing for the Input refactor.

**Prerequisites:**
- All previous tickets (opi-l3e.2, opi-l3e.3, opi-l3e.4) are complete
- All unit tests pass: `mix test apps/octo_pi_tui`

**Acceptance Criteria:**

Run `mix pi` in a tmux session and verify ALL of the following:

### 1. Basic Input Functionality
- [ ] Typing characters appears in the input field
- [ ] Backspace deletes characters before cursor
- [ ] Delete removes character at cursor
- [ ] Left/Right arrow keys move cursor
- [ ] Ctrl+A moves to line start
- [ ] Ctrl+E moves to line end
- [ ] Ctrl+U deletes to line start
- [ ] Ctrl+K deletes to line end
- [ ] Ctrl+W deletes word backward
- [ ] Ctrl+Y yanks deleted text

### 2. Multiline
- [ ] Shift+Enter inserts newline
- [ ] Arrow keys navigate between lines
- [ ] Backspace at start of line merges with previous line

### 3. History
- [ ] Up arrow recalls previous command
- [ ] Down arrow navigates forward in history
- [ ] Typing breaks history browsing

### 4. Autocomplete Dropdown
- [ ] Typing `/` shows autocomplete dropdown with commands
- [ ] Down arrow moves selection down in dropdown
- [ ] Up arrow moves selection up in dropdown  
- [ ] Tab accepts suggestion and inserts text
- [ ] Enter accepts suggestion AND submits the command
- [ ] Escape dismisses dropdown
- [ ] Continuing to type filters suggestions

### 5. Slash Commands Work
- [ ] `/help` shows help notification
- [ ] `/clear` clears the transcript
- [ ] `/model` opens model selector
- [ ] `/theme` shows theme notification

### 6. Submit Commands
- [ ] Plain text submits and appears in transcript
- [ ] `/command` executes slash command
- [ ] `!shell_command` executes shell command

### 7. Visual Correctness
- [ ] Input field has border
- [ ] Cursor is visible and positioned correctly
- [ ] Dropdown appears below input when active
- [ ] Dropdown scrolls when many suggestions

### 8. Scroll Behavior
- [ ] Long input text wraps correctly
- [ ] Scrolling keeps cursor visible
- [ ] Scroll indicators appear when needed

### 9. Edge Cases
- [ ] Empty input field renders correctly
- [ ] Very long single word wraps
- [ ] CJK characters display correctly
- [ ] Emoji display correctly
- [ ] Paste large text works

### 10. Cursor Position
- [ ] Cursor stays under typed character
- [ ] Cursor moves correctly after autocomplete acceptance
- [ ] Cursor position correct with dropdown visible

**Manual Test Commands:**

```bash
# Start a tmux session
tmux new-session -A -s octo_pi_test

# Run the app
cd /Users/j5n/Workspace/octo_pi
mix pi

# Test typing
hello[Enter]

# Test autocomplete
/[Down][Down][Tab]
# Should show dropdown, navigate, accept

# Test slash command
/clear[Enter]

# Test cursor movement
abcde[Left][Left][Backspace]

# Test multiline
test[Shift+Enter]multiline[Enter]

# Test history
[Up][Up][Down]

# Test paste
[Ctrl+Shift+V] (paste some text)

# Test shell command
!ls -la[Enter]

# Check context
!pwd[Enter]
```

**Unit Tests:**
```bash
# All tests should pass
mix test apps/octo_pi_tui

# Specifically the Input tests
mix test apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs
```

**Debugging:**
If issues occur:
1. Check `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
2. Run tests: `mix test apps/octo_pi_tui --trace`
3. Check for dialyzer warnings: `mix dialyzer`
4. Verify no calls to old API remain: `grep -r "render_dropdown" apps/octo_pi_tui/lib`
title: End-to-end verification: Input refactor acceptance
